bibl.title: A Greek Papyrus Fragment with a Citation of Matthew 1:20.
bibl.seg: Brice C. Jones, A Greek Papyrus Fragment with a Citation of Matthew 1:20.
bibl.note: 1. The fragment: P. Mich. Inv. 4944b. Provenance unknown, VI-VIIth cent. CE. - 2. The text. - 3. Commentary. - Both the format and a ritually charged content suggest this was most likely used as an amulet.
